target_type: flexible weekly intention, not daily prescription

counting_rule: Count actual Garmin Yoga activity elapsed duration in minutes, including partial sessions; deduplicate by Garmin activity ID across refreshes. Do not count projected time, running/strength workouts, or yoga activities outside this week. Do not double-count one session reported by both Garmin and the athlete.
excluded: Elastic/plyometrics deferred. Do not count strength, treadmill, or generic mobility as yin unless athlete explicitly says it is yin/deep stretch.
source: Athlete's Oct 18 instruction, FORM Athlete System support prescription; personal Rebuilt Athlete study.
primary_logging_source: Garmin Connect Yoga activity profile (completed synced sessions)
recording_workflow: On Garmin watch choose Yoga, record video/practice session, save activity, sync to Garmin Connect. No duplicate manual reporting needed.
import_method: On explicit study refresh, read Garmin-connected activity summaries, filter Yoga sessions dated 2026-10-19 through 2026-10-25, and import each unique completed activity (date, activity_id, duration_minutes, optional notes). The public study does not automatically sync.
history_limitation: Current Garmin connection on Free tier returns only two-day activity history; incomplete retrieval is not evidence of no sessions. Refresh at least every two days or backfill from exported Connect data/screenshots.
